items.name: base
items.title: renanleonel/ui
items.description: Everything: tokens, default theme, utils and all components.

items.name: tokens
items.title: Design tokens
items.description: Layer-2 tokens (control size, control radius, shadows) on top of the shadcn theme contract.

@utility motion-press.transition: transform var(--ds-duration-press) var(--ds-ease-out), background-color var(--ds-duration-press) ease, color var(--ds-duration-press) ease, box-shadow var(--ds-duration-press) ease

@utility motion-popover.transition: opacity var(--ds-duration-popover) var(--ds-motion-ease, var(--ds-ease-out)), transform var(--ds-duration-popover) var(--ds-motion-ease, var(--ds-ease-out))

@utility motion-tooltip.transition: opacity var(--ds-duration-tooltip) var(--ds-motion-ease, var(--ds-ease-out)), transform var(--ds-duration-tooltip) var(--ds-motion-ease, var(--ds-ease-out))

@utility motion-modal.transition: opacity var(--ds-duration-modal) var(--ds-motion-ease, var(--ds-ease-out)), transform var(--ds-duration-modal) var(--ds-motion-ease, var(--ds-ease-out))

dark.font-serif: ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif
dark.font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked sections that expand one or several at a time.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Asks for confirmation before a destructive action.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline message, as a bordered card or a tinted callout.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar group
items.description: Overlapping avatars built from a list of people, with a +N chip that lists the rest.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A user's picture with initials as fallback, alone or stacked.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status pills and counts in seven contrast-checked tones.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where this page sits in the hierarchy, with links back up.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Actions with press feedback, a smooth loading state and an optional hotkey.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a day or a range (react-day-picker).

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface with a header, content and footer.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A swipeable set of slides with arrows, dots, keyboard control, vertical and RTL support (embla).

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts with a validated categorical palette, DS tooltips and legends.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: On, off or mixed. The whole label toggles it.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single section that shows or hides its content from a trigger.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A color field that opens a saturation and hue area, an optional opacity slider, a hex input and preset swatches.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Type to filter a list and pick one value.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable list of commands, inline or as a Mod+K palette.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu at the pointer on right click or long press, styled like the dropdown menu.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: An icon button that copies a value and confirms with a check, a tooltip and a screen-reader announcement.

items.name: data-list
items.title: Data List
items.description: Label and value pairs that reflow with their container.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A form field that opens a calendar, for a single date, a range, or a date and time.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window. Becomes a bottom drawer on phones.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge and follows your finger.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A list of actions, with hotkeys, checkboxes, radios and submenus.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: What a region shows when there is nothing in it yet, and how to fill it.

items.name: error-state
items.title: Error State
items.description: A region that failed to load: what failed, a retry, and a request ID for support.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, control, description and error laid out together, vertically or horizontally.

items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: File Dropzone
items.description: Drop files or browse, with type and size limits and a removable list.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: react-hook-form and zod wired to fields: validation on blur, then live; a banner for server errors.

items.name: hotkey
items.title: Hotkey
items.description: Shows a shortcut for the user's platform: Mod+K reads ⌘K on macOS and Ctrl K elsewhere.

items.name: icon-tile
items.title: Icon Tile
items.description: An icon on a tinted square: the leading visual of rows, dialogs and results.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline edit
items.description: Text that becomes an input on click: Enter or blur saves, Escape cancels, with validation and optimistic async saves.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input with leading or trailing addons: icons, text, buttons.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time codes for 2FA and email verification.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text field sized by the control tokens.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row with media, title, description and actions.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key cap.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Names a control. Clicking it focuses or toggles the control.

items.name: language-select
items.title: Language Select
items.description: Pick the interface language, each name in its own language and script.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A row of menus for application commands, with arrow-key movement between them.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A value within a known range, such as storage used or seats taken.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: Pick several values as removable tags, with type-to-filter.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: The platform select, styled like the rest of the controls.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navigation: triggers open panels of links in one shared popup that resizes between them.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A numeric input with decrement and increment buttons, locale formatting and optional drag-to-scrub.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Links between pages of results.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: A tinted tray holding white cards with concentric corners.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field with a show/hide toggle and a Caps Lock warning.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Rich content anchored to a trigger. A bottom sheet on phones.

items.name: preview-card
items.title: Preview Card
items.description: A link that previews its destination on hover or focus.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How far along a task is.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Pick exactly one of a few visible options.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A star rating: a radio group when interactive, an image with fractions when read-only.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels split by draggable, keyboard-operable handles.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A scrolling region with overlay scrollbars that match the theme.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Pick one option from a list. The popup lines its selected item up with the trigger.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin rule between content.

items.name: settings-list
items.title: Settings List
items.description: One row per setting: title and description beside the control, hairline dividers, stacked when narrow.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A side panel for filters, details and navigation.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholders shaped like the content that is loading.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a value or a range by dragging.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toast
items.description: Transient notifications, including undo for reversible actions.

items.name: sortable
items.title: Sortable
items.description: A list you reorder by dragging, or with the keyboard.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate progress indicator.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Progress through a multi-step flow, horizontal or vertical, with complete, current, upcoming and error states.

items.name: swatch-picker
items.title: Swatch Picker
items.description: Pick one color from a row of swatches: accent colors, labels, themes.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A setting that applies immediately when toggled.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic table parts. For sorting, filters and pages use the Data Table block.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between views, as pills, a line or a sliding segmented control.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text that grows with its content.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: Light and dark in one button, or system / light / dark as a segmented switch.

items.name: time-input
items.title: Time Input
items.description: A time of day, typed in the browser's segmented field or picked from a styled list; plus a start–end range as one field.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A vertical history of events with tone markers: audit logs, order status, deploys.

items.name: timezone-select
items.title: Timezone Select
items.description: Search every IANA time zone by city, region or offset; virtualized.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A row of toggles, single or multiple choice: alignment, view modes, filters.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed: bold on, bold off.

items.name: token-input
items.title: Token Input
items.description: Free-form values as removable tokens: emails, keywords, domains.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of related actions with one tab stop and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label for an icon or a hint, with an optional hotkey.

items.name: tree-select
items.title: Tree Select
items.description: A select whose options are a searchable tree; pick one node or check several.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: A virtualized file-explorer tree with keyboard navigation, selection and filtering.

items.name: unsaved-changes-bar
items.title: Unsaved Changes Bar
items.description: A floating Discard / Save bar that rises in once a form has edits.

items.name: virtual-list
items.title: Virtual List
items.description: A scrolling list that renders only the items in view, for feeds and logs.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity feed
items.description: A day-grouped timeline of comments, status changes, assignments, uploads and mentions: filter by type in the URL, collapsed runs of similar events, relative times with the exact moment in a tooltip, and infinite loading.

items.name: ai-chat
items.title: AI chat
items.description: Streaming answers with Markdown and copyable code, collapsible tool calls, copy, regenerate and feedback, auto-scroll that lets go when you scroll up, and a composer with attachments and Stop.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Resizable sidebar (drag the edge; under 160px it settles to icons) with ease-out, cascade or scrub label motion, nested groups, Mod+K palette, G-then-key navigation, a sheet on mobile.

items.name: auth
items.title: Sign in
items.description: Google and SSO, email and password, and a banner for server errors.

items.name: billing
items.title: Pricing and billing
items.description: Monthly or yearly plans, usage meters and invoices.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: Mod+K palette with groups, recent items, nested pages, async search and keyboard hints.

items.name: dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: KPI tiles with sparklines, revenue and signup charts, activity and top projects; the range lives in the URL.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Search, filters, sort and pages kept in the URL, bulk actions and every loading state.

items.name: editable-table
items.title: Editable table
items.description: Cells edit in place and save one at a time: optimistic updates, a spinner per saving cell, rollback with Retry on error, and spreadsheet keys.

items.name: error-pages
items.title: Not found
items.description: 404, 403, 500 and maintenance pages with the way out.

items.name: file-manager
items.title: File manager
items.description: Folder tree, breadcrumb, grid and list views, multi-select, context menu, rename, move, upload with progress and a storage meter. Virtualized for thousands of files.

items.name: grouped-table
items.title: Grouped table
items.description: Rows in collapsible groups with pinned header, group bands and a calculation footer; continuous row numbers, group selection and a floating bulk-action bar.

items.name: inbox
items.title: Mail inbox
items.description: Resizable list and detail with a thread and reply composer; multi-select with archive, read and label actions, J/K/E/X keys, search and folder in the URL, a virtualized list, and list-to-detail navigation on phones.

items.name: infinite-table
items.title: Infinite table
items.description: Cursor pagination that loads ahead as you scroll: skeleton rows, inline retry, an end marker, a Load more fallback and back to top.

items.name: kanban
items.title: Kanban board
items.description: Columns with WIP limits and cards you drag between them or reorder, by pointer, touch or keyboard. Optimistic moves with rollback and Retry, a context menu, a details sheet and assignee and label filters in the URL.

items.name: marketing
items.title: Landing page
items.description: Marketing header (sheet on mobile, theme and language), hero with a framed product preview, logo cloud, feature grid and testimonials.

items.name: notifications
items.title: Notifications
items.description: A bell menu with unread count (Shift+N) and a full feed with mark as read and archive with undo.

items.name: onboarding
items.title: Setup wizard
items.description: Workspace, team and plan in steps: the step in the URL, validation per step, values kept going back, direction-aware transitions.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing page
items.description: Monthly/yearly plans with the saving inline, a comparison table that becomes a plan picker on phones, FAQ and a closing call to action.

items.name: schedule
items.title: Schedule
items.description: Month, week and day calendar: overlapping events side by side, all-day and multi-day banners, a current-time line, click-to-create, and an agenda list on narrow screens. View and date live in the URL; week start and formats follow the locale.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: Profile form, members and roles, and a delete confirmed by typing the name.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site footer
items.description: Brand, link columns, newsletter, then copyright, status, language and theme. Reflows with its container.
